title: Explicit underived free-source comparison
statement: For Λ:Type(u+1) a commutative ring, f:X→S, U in S.Etale and a Λ-module sheaf M on X, put L=f^*Λ[U], B=f^*Z[U], and a=f^*(freeMap)≫pullback. Then g↦a≫forget(g) gives a bijection Hom_Mod(L,M)→Hom_Ab(B,forget(M)). The map is precisely the canonical freeMap and Kan/sheafification pullback of def-sbc-raw-module-scalar-pullback-comparison, not a chosen isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 03D3 and 03D7, inverse-image adjunctions; Tag 03FD, equality of underlying section complexes

proof.text: Apply the module and abelian inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions, sheafification adjunctions, free adjunctions and Yoneda. Both Hom sets become the identical group of sections of f_*M at U.

Expand the inverse Kan-extension comparison and sheafification comparison defining pullback. Naturality of the sheafification unit and the inverse Kan-extension factorization give unit_Ab≫f_*(pullback)=forget(unit_Mod). Move f^*(freeMap) past the abelian unit by naturality. By the defining adjunction formula for freeMap, its identity generator is the module identity generator. Thus the displayed Hom map becomes identity on sections and is bijective.

mathlib_searches.query: Exact functor derived Hom comparison is injective when source Hom comparisons are bijective on injectives and forgotten injectives are acyclic
A pulled back free abelian represented sheaf corepresents evaluation and underlying injective module sheaves are acyclic for its Hom functor
mathlib_searches.results: Sheaf.H, cohomologyPresheafFunctor, GabrielPopescu.preservesInjectiveObjects; no matching scalar comparison.
InjectiveResolution.extAddEquivCohomologyClass and its apply/symm lemmas exist in Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Abelian.Injective.Ext.

No duplicate raw injectivity theorem. Found the free sections adjunction, ExtRightDerivedHom, the acyclic-resolution API, representedEquiv in RawRestrictedHomotopySectionsIso, and the proved evaluation-acyclicity helper in ModuleAbelianDerivedDirectImageComparison. The common-universe generic ringed-site lemma does not directly fit coefficients in u+1.

from.place: Resolution argument for the injective part of the explicit raw scalar comparison

lean.statement:
theorem rawModuleFreeSourceHom_bijective
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (U : S.Etale) (M : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) :
    Function.Bijective (fun g :
        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj ((freeSheaf Λ S).obj U) ⟶ M ↦
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).map
          (RawModuleScalarComparison.freeMap Λ S U) ≫
        RawModuleScalarComparison.pullback Λ f ((freeSheaf Λ S).obj U)) ≫
          (RawModuleScalarComparison.forget Λ X).map g)
